Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the timeline. Quick answers up front: yes, we have a SOC 2 Type II report with an audit period that runs 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; we can provide a redacted PDF copy and we can supply a signed bridge letter if you need to cover the Oct 1, 2024 - Sep 30, 2025 window.

Below is a short standard template we use internally for sharing and redaction guidance — happy to adapt to your procurement team's needs.

Standard share / redaction guidance:
- Deliverable: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + signed bridge letter (PDF or DocuSign).
- Redaction: remove customer-identifying details only (customer names, client-specific IP). Do not redact control descriptions, scope, control failures, or testing procedures.
- Format & transfer: preferred via SFTP (we can provision a time-limited account), or secure link to our encrypted drive folder (see Drive link below). If you prefer DocuSign for the bridge letter, we can send.
- Audit logs: we retain access and trace logs for 12 months by default; we can provide an attestation statement for a six-month retention SLA if needed.
- Timeline: we can deliver the redacted PDF + bridge letter draft within 3 business days of confirmation.

Attachments I will include on our first outbound: redacted_SOC2_2025.pdf (placeholder) and a bridge_letter_template_draft.docx.

Next steps: please confirm that SFTP is acceptable and whether procurement needs DocuSigned bridge letter or a signed PDF. Also confirm who should receive the files (email for SFTP creds or a secure upload link).

On the procurement logistics side, looping in Marissa (our security intake lead) and Karthik (compliance) to assist with transfer and any attestations.

Thanks,
